display_title: HORIZON-CL4-2027-04-DATA-09 Energy efficiency and sustainability of AI data processing in Data Centres (IA) – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL4-2027-04-DATA-09 Energy efficiency and sustainability of AI data processing in Data Centres (IA)
executive_summary: Supports open pilot sites that improve the energy efficiency of AI data processing, including a work area on integrating data centres into energy-system planning and operation. Eligible consortia can include data centre operators, technical partners and energy-system organisations for the integration work. The topic budget is EUR 39 million, with EUR 9–10 million expected per project. Opening 2026-11-17. Full proposal deadline 2027-03-18 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Digital, Industry and Space Work Programme, pp. 121–123, describes the eligible work in Scope. The Dutch beneficiary route is available subject to ownership screening. Scope area 6 explicitly covers energy-system planning and operation, where TenneT could validate grid-aware operation. This supports Type 1 and C1.3. Both project dates are date-helper defaults based on 1 January 2027 and 36 months.
